children: IN PREPARATION FOR TROPICAL STORM ISAIAS, HAVE INITIATED SHUT-IN PROCEDURES FOR PRODUCTION AT FOUR OF CHEVRON-OPERATED GULF OF AMERICA FACILITIES
SOME ADDITIONAL PERSONNEL ARE BEING TRANSPORTED ONSHORE, PRODUCTION FROM OTHER FIVE GULF OF AMERICA FACILITIES REMAINS AT NORMAL LEVELS
AT ONSHORE FACILITIES, CONTINUE TO FOLLOW ESTABLISHED STORM RESPONSE PROCEDURES
CLOSELY MONITORING THE PROJECTED PATH OF THE STORM
